verdict.rationale: The evidence clearly shows Justworks runs W-2 employee payroll: it collects withholding information in place of W-4s and has Pay > Make a Payment > Domestic flows. Contractors appear only once, in a payroll-adjustment context that asks for the 'employee or contractor name, payment type, and date of payment.' That hints contractor payments are handled on the same platform but never documents a contractor payment workflow. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of paying 1099 contractors (onboarding, payment run, 1099 filing), confirmation that W-2 and 1099 payments run from one unified flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can pay both W-2 employees and 1099 contractors from one platform

citations.quote: Justworks collects your employees' filing status, withholding, and exemption information when they enroll with Justworks, so that they don't need to file a W-4 themselves.
clicking on Pay in the side navigation menu > Make a Payment on the top right of the page > Domestic
let us know the employee or contractor name, payment type, and date of payment
